title: CODIS: Benchmarking Context-Dependent Visual Comprehension for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the relative frequencies of specific directional words ('up' and 'down') in model outputs on a subset of queries where the ground truth answers have an equal distribution of both words.

Calculating the relative frequencies of specific time-related words ('morning' and 'afternoon') in model outputs on a subset of queries where the ground truth answers have an equal distribution of both words.

Calculating the relative frequencies of appropriateness judgments ('appropriate' and 'not appropriate') in model outputs on a subset of queries where the ground truth answers have an equal distribution of both.
